design_tone: Restrained, ultra-polished, high-density B2B SaaS prospecting workspace with dark navy accents, crisp typography, and spacious data tables

font_rules.H1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-50
font_rules.Table_Headers: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 bg-slate-900/80
font_rules.Badges: text-xs font-medium tracking-wide uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full
font_rules.Code_Mono: font-mono text-xs text-blue-300 bg-slate-950/60 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-slate-800

spacing_and_layout.main_content_area: flex-1 overflow-y-auto bg-[#0A0D14] p-6 sm:p-8 lg:p-10
spacing_and_layout.grid_dashboard: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-5 mb-8

components_and_patterns.data_tables: Spacious, interactive data grid with column sorting, checkable rows, bulk enrich/export actions, status chips, and slide-over lead detail panel
components_and_patterns.navigation_header: Sticky glass header (bg-[#0A0D14]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-800/80 z-40) with search bar, credit balance pill counter, job status ticker, and quick action buttons
components_and_patterns.sidebar: Responsive Collapsible Sidebar featuring active indicator bar, credit usage widget, scraping jobs shortcut, and clean grouped section links
components_and_patterns.filters_bar: Multi-tier filter bar with Industry, Revenue, Employee Count, Location, Tech Stack, and Email Deliverability status badges
components_and_patterns.modals_and_drawers: Shadcn Dialog and Sheet with opaque dark surfaces (bg-[#121A29] border border-slate-800), backdrop-blur-md, clear headers, and explicit action buttons
components_and_patterns.charts: Recharts responsive area & bar charts with dark slate grid lines, blue/cyan gradient fills, custom HTML tooltips with high contrast
components_and_patterns.toasts: Sonner dark notifications with custom icons for Scrape completed, Email validated, Lead enriched, and CSV exported

motion_and_interactions.slide_over: framer-motion or CSS slide-in-from-right duration-300 ease-out for detail panel
motion_and_interactions.pulse_live_jobs: animate-pulse status dot for active scraping background jobs

team_office_1.description: Diverse B2B sales team analyzing data on laptops in modern glass office

team_office_2.description: Executive team portrait in enterprise software company

instructions_to_main_agent: Always apply data-testid to every interactive component (buttons, inputs, filters, table rows, checkboxes, dropdown items, tabs, modals).
Use dark navy and slate neutral dark backgrounds (#0A0D14, #121A29, #1E2B42) with bright blue (#2563EB, #60A5FA) accents for active states.
Ensure table cells have sufficient breathing room (px-6 py-4) and crisp subtle borders (border-slate-800).
Support complete lead prospecting flow: Search filters, lead select, enrichment trigger, real-time validation, list allocation, scraping job progress indicator, credit deduction, and CSV download.
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, modals, select menus, or sheet content to prevent text overlap and clipping.
Ensure text contrast meets WCAG AA standards in all states (normal, hover, active, focus). Explicitly pair dark background hovers with white or bright text (e.g. hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white).
Wrap stateful updates in TanStack Query mutations/queries with deterministic backend fallback handling so the application is fast, real, and fully functional.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.data_testid_requirement: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, select menus, links, checkboxes, modal triggers) MUST contain unique kebab-case data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.avoid_ai_slop: Do not use plain default white backgrounds or generic centered single-column layouts. Build rich B2B grid workspaces with slide-over drawers, metrics cards, table toolbar filters, and credit indicators.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.no_emoji_icons: Never use emoji characters (e.g., 🤖🧠💭💡🔮) as UI icons. Use Lucide icons (lucide-react).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.toast_system: Use Sonner for toast feedback on all primary actions (e.g., Lead Saved, CSV Exported, Enrichment Started, Scraper Job Queued).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.component_imports: Import Shadcn UI components from src/components/ui/ and icons from lucide-react.
